serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Detective: Sorry son. We are closing for today.
You: C-closing?! I waited so long!
Detective: Tough luck buddy. We in the force also need to sleep, y’know?
Detective: Tomorrow is another day.
You: Come on!
Detective: What? I get that it’s frustrating, but sometimes it is how it is. Our system isn’t perfect, but that’s the best we came up with so far. 
You: …
Detective: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Detective: Listen, the night duty officers will come here soon. If it’s something that cannot wait, ask them to fill the paperwork for me, ok?
You: Ok.
Detective: Oh! Speak of the devil! Here comes one of them.
